# `discriminator-mapping-added`

Discriminator mapping added

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` in requests, `warn` in responses |
| **Rule IDs** | `discriminator-mapping-added` (both directions), `discriminator-mapping-added-in-request`, `discriminator-mapping-added-in-response` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Schemas ([RULES.md section 7](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A new value in `discriminator.mapping` for a variant that was already there (an alias), or with no union beside it (a parent schema that children extend with `allOf`). A value added together with its `oneOf`/`anyOf` branch is reported as `union-branch-added` instead.

## Why this default

In requests: more values are valid. In responses: clients receive a variant name they do not know.

## Example

From test case [`discriminator-mapping-added`](../../test/cases/discriminator-mapping-added/): A discriminator value added to a response.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
          mapping:
            cat: '#/components/schemas/Cat'
+           dog: '#/components/schemas/Dog'
      Cat:
        type: object
```

Findings:

- `discriminator-mapping-added-in-response` · warn · #/components/schemas/Pet

| [`discriminator-mapping-orphaned-missing`](../../test/cases/discriminator-mapping-orphaned-missing/) | `discriminator-mapping-added-in-response` · warn · GET /pets | A discriminator value (fish) added to an inline response union for a schema that does not exist. The cat value names its target without a $ref and is fine; Owner has a mapping but no union (Person extends it with allOf), so it is not checked. |
| [`union-branch-added-with-alias`](../../test/cases/union-branch-added-with-alias/) | `discriminator-mapping-added-in-response` · warn · #/components/schemas/Pet | A branch added with its discriminator value, and an alias (kitty) added for an existing branch: the alias is still a mapping finding. |

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). See [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  discriminator-mapping-added: warn
```

## How to fix

Only return the new variant to clients that support it.
